### Country-specific policy context

<div class="country-policy-context">PQ used as part of radical cure in Nepal since 2009. G6PD testing is encouraged prior to 14 days PQ therapy but in case testing is not available closely supervised 14 days PQ therapy will be given. Counselling should be done to patient and followed up on days 3-7-14 days to monitor for adverse effects and compliance with primaquine. The program is planning the implementation of the STANDARD G6PD test after pilot at three health centres (ongoing). Implementation will be targeted at health facilities dependent on the health workforce and patient burden. At the community health unit (below health post), primaquine is provided for vivax without G6PD testing; however, per guidelines the lowest level providing primaquine is the health post. In terms of follow-up, there are feasibility challenges due to mobile migrant populations/seasonal workers.</div>
